# nsh-platform-gpui crate

> GPUI backend (macOS, Windows, Linux): nsh apps drawn by GPUI, embeddable in GPUI and GPUI Kit apps. Version 0.6.0, targets and dependencies.

## Workspace dependencies

[`gpui`](/crates/gpui/), `gpui_platform`, [`nsh-base`](/crates/nsh-base/), [`nsh-core`](/crates/nsh-core/), [`nsh-dev`](/crates/nsh-dev/), [`nsh-engine`](/crates/nsh-engine/), [`nsh-testing`](/crates/nsh-testing/). It also uses 29 crates from outside the workspace.

## Used by

[`gpui_ui`](/crates/gpui_ui/), [`nsh-gpui-host`](/crates/nsh-gpui-host/)

## Features

`crypto`, `default`, `dev`, `editor`, `emoji-picker`, `highlight`, `js`, `math`, `net`, `plot`, `rich-editor`, `runtime-shaders`, `shader`, `shot`, `svg`, `term`, `updater`, `video`, `websocket`, `webview`, `zlib`

## Build

Run this from the repository root.

```bash
cargo build --release -p nsh-platform-gpui
```
